# QUBE Smart Lockers

> QUBE Smart Lockers builds connected smart locker systems for businesses — secure,
> self-service storage for terminals, campuses, hospitals, factories, offices, malls and events.
> The company behind the products is QUBE Smart Technology Corp.

This file is a plain-text map of the public site for automated readers. It is a courtesy index, not
a substitute for the pages themselves, and it contains no content that is not already public.

## Canonical origin

https://business.qubesmartlockers.com

All canonical URLs, Open Graph tags, structured data and sitemap entries on the site use this origin.
The company's separate marketing site is https://www.qubesmartlockers.com/.

## Company

- Public brand: QUBE Smart Lockers
- Registered name: QUBE Smart Technology Corp.
- Also known as: QUBE, QUBE Smart Technology
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/qube-smart-technology
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/qubesmartlockers/
- Company site: https://www.qubesmartlockers.com/

## Public pages

- https://business.qubesmartlockers.com/ — overview, the industries QUBE builds for, and an enquiry form
- https://business.qubesmartlockers.com/products — the catalogue, one entry per product
- https://business.qubesmartlockers.com/products/{slug} — one page per product
- https://business.qubesmartlockers.com/sitemap.xml — every public URL, with the date each last changed

## Not public

- `/cms/*` is the authenticated content management area. It is excluded here and in `robots.txt`, it
  sets `noindex`, and it holds no public content.

## Notes on this site's content

- Product facts are stored in a content management system and rendered server-side, so a product page
  always describes the product as it is currently published.
- Every product page states what the product is, who it is for, and where it is installed, in prose
  on the page itself. No summary on this site is machine-only.
- The site publishes no prices, ratings or reviews, because QUBE does not publish them anywhere else
  either. Nothing in the structured data claims otherwise.
